scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: F# typed list pipeline sum
checks.code:
module Museum

[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    [1..10] |> List.sum |> printfn "%d"
    0

checks.name: F# discriminated union and pattern matching
checks.code:
module Museum
type Shape = Circle of int | Rectangle of int * int
let area = function Circle r -> 3*r*r | Rectangle(w,h) -> w*h
[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    printfn "%d" (area (Rectangle(3,4)))
    0

checks.name: F# record update
F# multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code:
module Museum

[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    System.Console.InputEncoding <- System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false)
    System.Console.OutputEncoding <- System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false)
    for _ in 1..2 do
        printfn "[%s]" (System.Console.ReadLine())
    0

checks.name: F# type error prevents execution
checks.code:
module Museum

[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    printfn "MUST_NOT_RUN"
    let n:int = "wrong"
    printfn "%d" n
    0

result.compilerStderr:
/work/Main.fs(6,17): error FS0001: This expression was expected to have type
    'int'    
but here has type
    'string'

checks.name: F# unhandled exception fails
checks.code:
module Museum

[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    failwith "intentional error"
    0

result.stderr:
Unhandled exception. System.Exception: intentional error
   at Museum.main(String[] _arg1)

checks.name: F# handled exception succeeds
checks.code:
module Museum

[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    try failwith "expected" with _ -> printfn "handled"
    0

checks.name: F# missing package fails without restore
checks.code:
module Museum
open MuseumMissingLibrary
[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    printfn "MUST_NOT_RUN"
    0

result.compilerStderr: /work/Main.fs(2,6): error FS0039: The namespace or module 'MuseumMissingLibrary' is not defined.

checks.name: F# timeout
checks.code:
module Museum

[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    while true do
        ()
    0
